final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT q.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM qualifying AS q JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId GROUP BY q.constructorId, c.nationality), nationality_totals AS (SELECT nationality, SUM(match_count) AS total_count FROM group_counts GROUP BY nationality), ratios AS (SELECT g.constructorId, g.nationality, g.match_count, 1.0 * g.match_count / t.total_count AS ratio FROM group_counts AS g JOIN nationality_totals AS t ON g.nationality = t.nationality), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT r.constructorId, r.nationality, r.match_count, r.ratio, r.ratio / o.average_ratio AS normalized_ratio FROM ratios AS r JOIN overall AS o ON o.average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY normalized_ratio IS NULL, normalized_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
